# Recorded responses

`sts-11.14.0` is a trimmed recording of the public routes `dr platform describe` reads, taken from a single-tenant 11.14.0 install on 2026-10-06. Account data is dropped, the host and IDs are replaced, and lists are cut to a few entries. Field names, types, and the paged envelope are as the install returned them. The install allocates no seat licenses, and two of its environments share a name.

`{{BASE}}` stands for the test server's address.
